caption: The drawing depicts a decorative chain composed of three gold-colored, oval-shaped links with engraved designs on each one, connected by four smaller, black circular links. The chain is arranged in a gentle U-shape against a plain beige background. The engraved designs on the oval links include symmetrical, ornate patterns. The two ends of the chain terminate in hook shapes, also gold in color, appearing ready to be attached or fastened to something. The overall composition is centered on the page with no additional objects or background elements.
title: Necklace
